title: Freddie Blackburn's family tragedy
summary: Drummer Freddie Blackburn, a Canadian of West Indian and French parentage, survived because he was at the movies when his father killed the family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Then we had a fellow, his name was Freddie Blackburn. his father was West Indian, his mother French Now, Freddie was a Canadian, he was Canadian, but -- this poor boy, there was an awful calamity in his life.

It seems that he had six sisters and he himself, I think what I am hearing, is that his father, when they came of age to understand, they were trying to make fun of the Metis-- father because him being black and they were being -/- mixed and everything, they would make fun of him.
And so, it seems that, as though the father one day killed the whole family and the only thing to save Freddie was that he was in the movies. So, that was Freddie.
